يخضوضب (form XII)
# يَخْضَوْضِبُ (yaḵḍawḍibu) /jax.dˤaw.dˤi.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِخْضَوْضَبَ (iḵḍawḍaba)
# يَخْضَوْضِبَ (yaḵḍawḍiba) /jax.dˤaw.dˤi.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِخْضَوْضَبَ (iḵḍawḍaba)
# يَخْضَوْضِبْ (yaḵḍawḍib) /jax.dˤaw.dˤib/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِخْضَوْضَ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
